description: The figure is a 3D bar chart illustrating model accuracy across two task types for two language models. The category axis is arranged along the base with task labels “Generation” and “Classification” shown on the right-hand side, and model labels “Davinci-003” and “BARD” shown on the left-hand side; the chart uses a perspective 3D layout rather than a single flat categorical axis. The value axis is the vertical axis labeled “Accuracy,” shown with a linear scale and tick marks at approximately 0.2 intervals (0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8), with the plotted range extending from near 0 up to just under 0.9. There are four rectangular prism bars (one per model–task combination) rendered with a blue-to-green-to-yellow gradient (blue near the base transitioning to yellow near the top). For Davinci-003, the Generation bar reaches roughly 0.45 accuracy and the Classification bar reaches roughly 0.75. For BARD, the Generation bar reaches roughly 0.25 and the Classification bar reaches roughly 0.70. The bars are displayed as a 2×2 grid in depth corresponding to the two models and two tasks, with no stacking, no legend, no visible error bars, and no explicit sorting beyond the fixed placement by model and task; no individual bar appears specially highlighted beyond the shared gradient coloring.
